scenes.narration: ज़रा सोचिए… अगर आपको आज से 10,000 साल पीछे भेज दिया जाए,
scenes.image_prompt: A close-up of the Modern Observer’s eye, a woman in her mid-20s with clean features. In the reflection of her dark iris, a tiny, glowing prehistoric campfire flickers against a jagged mountain silhouette at night. Her skin is softly lit by a blue glow from a hidden screen, while the reflection in her eye holds a warm, primitive orange spark. The mood is contemplative and deep, bridging the gap between two eras.

scenes.narration: ऐसी दुनिया में जहाँ ना बिजली है,
scenes.image_prompt: A low-angle dramatic shot of a towering modern skyscraper, its glass windows dark and lifeless against a deep, starless indigo sky. A single, thick, withered vine crawls up the cold concrete side, symbolizing nature slowly reclaiming the urban landscape. The environment is silent and eerie, with heavy shadows and a muted color palette that suggests a world where modern power has completely vanished, leaving only an empty shell of technology.

scenes.narration: ना मोबाइल, ना अस्पताल और ना ही खाने के लिए कोई सुपरमार्केट…
scenes.image_prompt: A backlit wide shot of a cracked smartphone lying abandoned in tall, dry prehistoric grass. The screen is black and dead, reflecting nothing. In the background, the vast, untamed wilderness of 10,000 BC stretches toward a jagged mountain range under a cold, misty dawn sky. The pale, desaturated light highlights the total uselessness of the modern device in this ancient, rugged world. The atmosphere is lonely and emphasizes the harsh reality of survival.

scenes.narration: तो क्या आप एक हफ्ते भी ज़िंदा रह पाएँगे?
scenes.image_prompt: A medium shot of the Modern Observer, a woman in her mid-20s wearing a simple grey hoodie, standing alone in a dense, primeval forest. She is shivering, her arms wrapped tightly around her body, and her breath forms a faint mist in the cold, damp air. Massive, moss-covered trees loom over her like giants, and the ground is cluttered with sharp rocks and tangled roots. The lighting is dim and moody, capturing her vulnerability and fear.

scenes.narration: क्योंकि आज आप जिस आरामदायक दुनिया में जी रहे हैं,
scenes.image_prompt: A top-down view of a clean, minimalist wooden desk in a modern room. A steaming white ceramic mug of coffee sits next to a sleek, closed laptop and a small green succulent in a pot. The lighting is warm and soft, casting gentle shadows and creating a sense of absolute safety and domestic peace. The composition is orderly and calm, representing the pinnacle of modern comfort and the predictability of contemporary life.

scenes.narration: वहाँ तक पहुँचने के लिए आपके पूर्वजों ने हज़ारों साल
scenes.image_prompt: A wide establishing shot of a rugged mountain ridge at sunset. A small line of human silhouettes, the Tribe, moves slowly across the horizon in a single file. They carry long wooden spears and bundles of animal hides. The sky is a deep, bruised purple and orange, with the sun dipping below the peaks. The vastness of the prehistoric landscape emphasizes the immense scale of time and the long, difficult journey of human migration.

scenes.narration: तक प्रकृति के खिलाफ एक मुश्किल जंग लड़ी थी।
scenes.image_prompt: A side view of the Protagonist Ancestor, a man in his 30s with tangled dark hair and weathered, rugged skin. He leans with grit into a fierce, wind-blown rainstorm on a rocky cliffside. He wears dark brown animal hide wraps, and his lean muscles are tense as he grips a hand-knapped stone spear. His expression is one of intense determination against the grey, violent elements of the wilderness, lit by cold, flickering lightning.

scenes.narration: कल्पना कीजिए… आप 10,000 साल पहले की दुनिया में हैं।
scenes.image_prompt: A symbolic close-up of a weathered, mud-stained hand pressing firmly into damp, dark earth. The skin of the palm is calloused and highly textured from years of hard labor. Beside the hand, a sharp, triangular flint arrowhead lies half-buried in the soil. The lighting is low and earthy, focusing on the tactile, raw connection between the human and the unyielding ground of the ancient past. The mood is heavy and grounded.

scenes.narration: उस समय इंसान आज की तरह बड़े-बड़े शहरों में नहीं,
scenes.image_prompt: A close-up of a primitive cave wall made of rough, damp limestone. The surface is covered in faint, ochre-colored handprints and simple charcoal drawings of migrating bison and deer. The texture of the stone is cold and uneven. Soft, flickering orange light from an unseen fire nearby dances across the wall, highlighting the cracks and natural imperfections of this ancient dwelling, serving as a visual metaphor for the earliest human homes.

scenes.narration: बल्कि छोटे-छोटे समूहों में रहता था।
scenes.image_prompt: A low-angle dramatic shot looking up at the Tribe, a group of five individuals including men and women, standing together on a jagged rocky outcrop. They are huddled close for warmth, wearing simple, dark animal furs. The Protagonist Ancestor stands at the front, his intense eyes looking out into a misty valley below. The composition makes the group look small yet resilient against the massive, overwhelming scale of the prehistoric mountain range.

scenes.narration: कई समूह गुफाओं या प्राकृतिक चट्टानों की आड़ में अपना ठिकाना बनाते थे,
scenes.image_prompt: A wide shot from inside a deep, dark limestone cave looking out toward the jagged entrance. The figures of the Tribe are seen as dark silhouettes against the cold, blue twilight sky visible through the cave mouth. A small, glowing ember of a central campfire sits on the cave floor, casting long, dramatic shadows against the cavern walls. The atmosphere is one of sanctuary and quiet belonging amidst a vast and dangerous prehistoric world.

scenes.narration: ताकि बारिश, ठंड और जंगली जानवरों से बच सकें।
scenes.image_prompt: A medium shot of the Protagonist Ancestor, the man in his 30s with weathered skin, sitting near the edge of the cave entrance. He watches a torrential downpour that turns the primeval forest into a blur of grey and green. He holds a wooden spear shaft in his hand, his face partially illuminated by the warm, flickering orange glow of the fire behind him. He looks tired but watchful, the cave providing the only safety from the wild.

scenes.narration: लेकिन सिर्फ़ छत होने से ज़िंदगी आसान नहीं हो जाती थी।
scenes.image_prompt: A top-down view of the Protagonist Ancestor lying on a cold, hard limestone cave floor. He is curled up on a thin, dark brown animal hide, his weathered skin and lean muscles visible in the dim light. The stone floor is uneven and damp, with long shadows stretching across the cavern. The lighting is cool and blue-toned, emphasizing the discomfort and the harsh, unforgiving reality of their primitive shelter during a restless night.

scenes.narration: खाने के लिए उन्हें जंगलों में फल,
scenes.image_prompt: A wide establishing shot of a dense, primeval forest at dawn. The Protagonist Ancestor and two tribe members are seen from a distance, appearing small against the towering, ancient trees with thick trunks. Mist clings to the mossy ground as they carefully reach into thorny bushes to gather small wild berries. The atmosphere is quiet and focused, with soft morning light filtering through the thick canopy, creating a sense of vast, untamed wilderness.

scenes.narration: जड़ें और खाने लायक पौधे ढूँढने पड़ते थे।
scenes.image_prompt: A side view of a female tribe member kneeling on the damp forest floor. She uses a sharp, pointed wooden stick to dig into the dark earth, unearthing a gnarled, edible root. Her hands are stained with soil and her expression is one of intense concentration. Beside her, a primitive basket made of woven reeds holds a few gathered plants. The background is a soft blur of forest greenery, lit by earthy, natural light.

scenes.narration: कई बार पूरा समूह मिलकर हिरण जैसे जानवरों का शिकार करता था।
scenes.image_prompt: A low-angle symbolic shot focusing on a pair of mud-caked feet and the sharpened tips of three stone spears held firmly by the tribe members. The spears are pointed toward a distant, blurred forest clearing where a deer might hide. The grass is tall, dry, and golden. The composition suggests the synchronized, stealthy movement of the group closing in on their prey. The mood is tense and expectant, with high-contrast shadows on the ground.

scenes.narration: पत्थरों से बने नुकीले औज़ार और भाले उनके सबसे बड़े हथियार थे।
scenes.image_prompt: An extreme close-up of the Protagonist Ancestor’s calloused hands expertly lashing a sharp, knapped flint arrowhead to a wooden shaft using strips of dried animal sinew. The texture of the grey stone is jagged and raw. The background is the warm, out-of-focus interior of the limestone cave. The lighting highlights the intricate detail of the primitive craftsmanship and the strength in his fingers as he prepares his primary weapon for survival.

scenes.narration: और अब आती है उनकी सबसे बड़ी खोजों में से एक… आग!
scenes.image_prompt: A dramatic low-angle shot looking up at the Protagonist Ancestor as he holds a small, glowing ember nestled in a bed of dry moss and twigs. His face is illuminated by a warm, orange flicker, his eyes wide with a mix of awe and intensity. Behind him, the dark cave ceiling towers into shadow. The glow of the newly birthed fire creates a powerful emotional contrast against the deep, cold blues of the prehistoric night.

scenes.narration: आग सिर्फ़ खाना पकाने के काम नहीं आती थी।
scenes.image_prompt: A backlit wide shot from deep inside the dark cave. The silhouette of a tribe member is seen holding a burning torch aloft, walking toward the cave entrance. The orange light spills onto the jagged, textured limestone walls, casting long, dancing shadows that stretch across the floor. In the foreground, a piece of meat hangs near a smaller central fire, but the focus is on the light expanding and reclaiming the space from the darkness.

scenes.narration: रात के अंधेरे में यही उनकी रोशनी थी।
scenes.image_prompt: A medium shot of the Tribe gathered around a central flickering campfire inside the cave at night. The Protagonist Ancestor sits with his back to the stone wall, the warm light painting his weathered features and dark hair. The other four members are huddled close, their faces glowing in the amber light while the rest of the cave remains shrouded in deep, protective shadows. The mood is one of intimate safety and ancestral belonging.

scenes.narration: इसी से वे खुद को ठंड से बचाते
scenes.image_prompt: A top-down view of the tribe members sleeping in a tight circle around the dying, glowing embers of the central fire. They are covered in thick, dark brown animal hides, their bodies overlapping to share warmth. The orange glow of the embers provides a soft, warm center to the composition, while the edges of the frame are a frosty, deep blue, representing the biting cold of the prehistoric winter air just outside the fire's reach.

scenes.narration: और जंगली जानवरों को अपने ठिकानों से दूर रखने की कोशिश करते थे।
scenes.image_prompt: A wide establishing shot looking out from the mouth of the cave into the pitch-black prehistoric night. Two small, glowing predatory eyes are visible in the distant, dark forest. In the foreground, the bright, crackling flames of a large fire at the cave entrance act as a glowing barrier. The contrast between the safe, warm orange light of the human habitat and the terrifying, cold blackness of the wild wilderness is stark and atmospheric.

scenes.narration: लेकिन असली सर्वाइवल सिर्फ़ शिकार और आग तक सीमित नहीं था।

He is looking out over a vast, sweeping valley, silently observing the migration patterns of a distant herd of animals. He holds a stone spear, but his posture is one of deep thought and analysis rather than aggression. The sky is a muted purple and gold, casting a contemplative light over the ancient landscape.

scenes.narration: वे जानवरों की गतिविधियों को समझते,
scenes.image_prompt: A close-up of a fresh animal track—a deep, clear hoof print in the soft mud of a riverbank. The lighting is soft and directional, highlighting the texture of the mud and the lines on the man's skin. This symbolic shot represents the birth of human observation and the understanding of nature.
